meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides Shopify.com marketing videos and logo animations; blur or hide page pictures
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, iPhone UA 390x844 in headless Chrome, shopify.com home page. Counts are `querySelectorAll` on the rendered DOM saved from that load (scripts then switched off to evaluate): marketing videos 13 plus 1 testimonial play button, logo animation 1, flag carousel 1, body pictures (see playbook). No cookie banner, chat widget or announcement bar appeared for this session. The `Scrolling animation` rule matches an English `aria-label` and will not match other languages.

NOT verified: the pricing, blog and help pages, apps.shopify.com, desktop layout, the language popover, cookie consent in the EU, the original ad and app-banner rules. Only three new options were added because the page has few annoyances.
